name: Alex
source:
"Please ask me anything about this city. I'm very knowledgeable about it."

A boy who helps out at Carmen's store. As he has no relatives, he lives in an orphanage. Though he's docile and polite, he also has an appropriately childish innocence about him. Knowledgeable in various things about New Sieg, he often helps Teuta by gathering and giving her information about the city.

[spoiler]Full name: Alex Spencer.[/spoiler]
